reset_SpotNavEnv: reset the SpotNavEnv with a goal position, heading, and optional dynamic yaw flag
enable_nav_by_hand: enable hand-based navigation observation by switching get_nav_observation to use hand camera coordinates
get_hand_xy_theta: get the x, y, and theta of the hand camera from the robot kinematic state
get_success: check navigation success based on distance and angle thresholds and stop the base if successful
step_SpotNavEnv: step the navigation environment with docking support and dynamic base slowdown near the goal
